dishes.name: Kategna
dishes.description: A popular Ethiopian dish made by toasting a piece of flatbread and coating it in a spiced butter and chili mixture.

dishes.name: Lentil Sambusas
dishes.description: (Ye Misir Sambusa) Golden, crispy pastry triangles packed with a savory, aromatically spiced lentil filling with garlic, ginger, jalapeños, and warm spices.

dishes.name: Lega Tibs
dishes.description: Yabera Lega Tibs is a premier Ethiopian beef dish known for its tender texture and mild, savory flavor. Flash-fried quickly to keep the meat incredibly juicy.

dishes.name: Chekina Tibs
dishes.description: A traditional Ethiopian dish of cubed beef or lamb, seared with niter kibbeh (spiced clarified butter), onions, garlic, ginger, and rosemary. Served on a heated clay pot.

dishes.name: Geba Weta
dishes.description: A fast-paced Ethiopian dish featuring bite-sized tenderloin or sirloin steak cooked medium-rare alongside onions, jalapeños, rosemary, and savory spices.

dishes.name: Beef Hot Grilled
dishes.description: (Shekla Tibs) A sizzling, aromatic Ethiopian dish featuring juicy beef chunks seared with Niter Kibbeh, red onions, jalapeños, and traditional spices.

dishes.name: Yabera Lega Tibs
dishes.description: A premier Ethiopian beef dish known for its tender texture and mild, savory flavor. Flash-fried quickly to keep the meat incredibly juicy.

dishes.name: Beef Ribs
dishes.description: Ethiopian beef short ribs, served as Derek Tibs (dry) or braised with berbere, are savory, spicy, and tenderized with spiced butter (kibe).

dishes.name: Gaslight Tibs
dishes.description: Meat quickly seared over extreme heat with onions, jalapeños, rosemary, and kibe (spiced butter), finished with a touch of red wine and berbere.

dishes.name: Gaslight (Special Kitfo)
dishes.description: Hand-diced tender beef round prepared in front of you, mixed with freshly ground cardamom, Ethiopian purified butter, and spiced hot chili powder. Served with cheeses.

dishes.name: Tebit Kitffo
dishes.description: Lean ground beef seasoned and cooked with cardamom, spicy chili powder, onions, jalapeño, and Ethiopian herbal butter.

dishes.name: Gored Gored
dishes.description: A popular Ethiopian dish consisting of cubed, raw beef (typically tenderloin) tossed in niter kibbeh (spiced clarified butter) and mitmita (hot chili powder blend).

dishes.name: Raw Meat
dishes.description: Kurt (ቁርጥ) also called Tire Siga (ጥሬ ስጋ) is a flavorful Ethiopian raw meat delicacy served with spicy condiments.

dishes.name: Quanta Firfir
dishes.description: A savory Ethiopian breakfast dish of diced dried beef (quanta) simmered in a spicy, butter-based sauce (berbere and kibbeh) and mixed with shredded injera.

dishes.name: Bozena Shiro
dishes.description: A popular, comforting dish combining traditional spiced chickpea stew (shiro) with tender cubes of sautéed beef or lamb (tibs).

dishes.name: Fish Goulash
dishes.description: Asa Goulash (Ye'assa Wat) is a beloved and vibrant dish combining crispy, pan-fried fish simmered in a rich, spicy, and citrusy tomato sauce.

dishes.name: Veggie Combo
dishes.description: Combination of Vegetarian dishes: Yemisir Wat, Kik Alicha, Debelek Atekelete, Misir Azifa, Shiro, Gomen, Elebete, Salad, Beetroot.

dishes.name: Pasta
dishes.description: This Ethiopian pasta recipe features a fragrant, spicy tomato sauce (sils) enhanced with aromatic berbere spice, onions, garlic, and ginger.

dishes.name: Chicken Nugget (Kids)
dishes.description: Crispy chicken nuggets served for kids.

dishes.name: Spaghetti (Kids)
dishes.description: Classic spaghetti for kids.
